notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
The new patch includes several changes to align the PC version with the Nintendo Switch version, including:
[list]
[*] General game balancing.
[*] Addition of icons indicating respawn points.
[*] Minor UI fixes, specifically regarding language settings.
[*] Saved files now respawn the player at the last spawn point visited (previously at the beginning of each scene).
[/list]
